title: ctDNA-Guided Neoadjuvant Therapy in HER2+ Breast Cancer
official: Individualized Neoadjuvant De-Escalation of T-DXd in HER2+ Breast Cancer (INDEX-HER2)
summary:
The convergence of evidence from neoCARHP (comparable pCR between TCHP and THP in an unselected population), DB-11 (activity of T-DXd-THP in high-risk HER2-positive early breast cancer), and I-SPY2 ctDNA data (early ctDNA clearance predicts favorable response and outcomes) provides a strong rationale for biomarker-guided treatment selection. This study uses early on-treatment ctDNA response after standardized THP induction to direct therapy intensity rather than reflexively escalating all patients.

Unlike non-biomarker-selected escalation approaches, this study uses ctDNA as a dynamic biomarker to tailor therapy: patients with early molecular clearance continue THP without carboplatin or ADC exposure, while patients with persistent molecular tumor burden escalate to T-DXd.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Newly diagnosed, histologically confirmed stage II-III HER2-positive breast cancer (HER2-positive defined per ASCO/CAP guidelines: IHC 3+ or ISH-amplified)
* No prior systemic therapy for breast cancer
* Adequate tumor tissue available for molecular profiling and ctDNA assay design
* Adequate peripheral blood samples obtainable for serial ctDNA testing
* Age ≥ 18 years
* ECOG performance status 0-2
* Adequate organ function as defined by:

  * Absolute neutrophil count (ANC) ≥ 1,500/µL
  * Platelets ≥ 100,000/µL
  * Hemoglobin ≥ 9.0 g/dL
  * Total bilirubin ≤ 1.5 × upper limit of normal (ULN)
  * AST/ALT ≤ 2.5 × ULN
  * Creatinine clearance ≥ 50 mL/min (Cockcroft-Gault)
  * Left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) ≥ 55% by echocardiogram or MUGA scan
* Women of childbearing potential must have a negative pregnancy test and agree to use effective contraception during treatment and for the protocol-specified period after the last dose of HER2-directed therapy/T-DXd, per applicable prescribing information and institutional standards.
* Written informed consent obtained from subject and ability for subject to comply with the requirements of the study.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Distant metastatic disease (Stage IV)
* Prior invasive breast cancer within the past 5 years
* Prior chemotherapy, radiation therapy, or targeted therapy for current breast cancer
* Known hypersensitivity to any component of the treatment regimen, including docetaxel, trastuzumab, pertuzumab, or T-DXd
* Active cardiac disease including: congestive heart failure (NYHA Class II or above), unstable angina, myocardial infarction within 6 months, uncontrolled hypertension, or clinically significant arrhythmia
* Pregnant or breastfeeding
* History of, or current, interstitial lung disease/pneumonitis; active uncontrolled infection requiring systemic therapy
* Any other condition that, in the opinion of the investigator, would make the patient unsuitable for study participation.
